entries.text: [EMPTY 64]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_first_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 64]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_first_01

entries.text: Yo, Champ.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_00

entries.text: Gotta thank you again for conquering the\nBB League.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_01

entries.text: All the tension here melted right away once we\ngot our new Champion![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_02

entries.text: If I had my Drayster druthers, Kieran and I’d be\nhaving fun battling again...[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_03

entries.text: I thought we’d have patched things up by now,\nbut I guess things ain’t that simple.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_04

entries.text: It’ll work out!
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_select_01

entries.text: Just give it time!
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_select_02

entries.text: You know just what to say, huh? Good quality in\na reigning Champion![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_05

entries.text: Guess I ended up kinda using you to try and get\nwhat I wanted, huh, bud?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_06

entries.text: Sorry about that. I didn’t mean to. I dropped the\nslacker life for once, and I just got carried away.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_07

entries.text: Anyway, hope you’ll accept my apology.\nNo attitude, just gratitude.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_08

entries.text: How goes the busy life of the League Club\npresident? Nose to the grindstone?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_01

entries.text: “President”?!
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_select_01

entries.text: Wait—me?!
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_select_02

entries.text: Hang on, you didn’t know? Yeah, the BB League\nChamp doubles as president. So that’s officially\r\nyou now. Them’s the breaks![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_02

entries.text: I didn’t know!
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_select_03

entries.text: No one told me!
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_select_04

entries.text: My bad! Yeah, that’s the deal![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_03

entries.text: Don’t worry about it, though! We all got your\nback.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_04

entries.text: Even when I was on top of the game, I made it a\npoint to not call myself Champion.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_05

entries.text: That way the Elite Four of us could just trade off\nclub prez duties...and I wouldn’t have to do ’em\r\nall myself![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_06

entries.text: Anyway, I’ll take responsibility if anything gets\nhairy, so don’t worry. Dive in and prez it up, prez![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_07

entries.text: Yo yo, bud. Got an update regarding the “you\nbeing League Club president” thing. And I quote:[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_00

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]“Foisting all those responsibilities onto
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]—that’s
just
not right!”[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_01

entries.text: Yeah, Lacey really raked me over the coals for\nthat—and for my general slack-offery.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_02

entries.text: And so...guess we’re now all stuck splitting\nLeague Club president duties again.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_03

entries.text: Give it your all!
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_select_01

entries.text: Congrats, co-prez!
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_select_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]With all due respect, [VAR 0x0100(0000)],
the
Drayster’s
trying
to
give
way
less
than
that![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_04

entries.text: Whoof! Didn’t take you for the facetious\ntype, bud![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_04b

entries.text: I’m really not excited about having more work...[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_05

entries.text: Feel free to come take some off my plate if you\never feel like helping. Seriously. Any time. Help.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_06

entries.text: Come to think of it, part of a club president’s job\nis supporting the other members, right?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_01_00

entries.text: Guess I can do that much![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_01_01

entries.text: Supportive mode, activate! Let’s trade\nPokémon...supportively![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_01_02

entries.text: That’s what I like to hear. I’m putting up\nDuraludon, obviously! What’ll you trade me?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_01_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0101(0001)]’s a great choice.
That’s
a
Champion’s
Pokémon
for sure!\c
Don’t worry. I may slack on a lot of stuff, but I’ll
take good care of your [VAR 0x0101(0001)].[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_01_04

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So you’re down to trade your [VAR 0x0101(0001)]
for
my
Duraludon, bud?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_02_00

entries.text: You can’t trade Drayton a Pokémon if you\naren’t its original Trainer!
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_02_01

entries.text: You can’t trade Drayton such a rare Pokémon!
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_02_02

entries.text: You can’t trade Drayton a Shiny Pokémon!
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_02_03

entries.text: Hang on, bud. You’ve only got one Pokémon with\nyou. You gotta bring more, or we can’t trade.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_03_00

entries.text: Aw, c’mon...don’t be like that! We gotta work\ntogether here![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_03_01

entries.text: Oooh, you feeling that team spirit now? Let’s\ntrade it up, then![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_04_00

entries.text: Hey, bud. You up for a battle?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_talkto_00

entries.text: Fair enough! You can’t go giving 100 percent all\nthe time. Gotta know when to hit the brakes.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_cancel_00

entries.text: Nice. Let’s stroll on over to the battle court, then.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battlestart_00

entries.text: Uh, hang on, bud! We’re going for a Double\nBattle. Better bring at least one more Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battlestart_01

entries.text: Man, facing off against you is ridiculous.\nSo much fun![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: I’ve got something for you, bud. A little token of\nmy everlasting gratitude.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: Here—don’t mind the dust! I really oughta clean\nmy closet.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: Now we can be twinsies! Heh heh.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: You received a [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Tracksuit (Black / Gold) [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]from\nDrayton!
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_reward_00

entries.text: There you go again getting even better. Guess I\nshould’ve expected that, huh, bud?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: Y’know, I think I’ve come to rely on our battles\nas a way to de-stress![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text:
Heh heh! Don’t mind me, just scooping up a W
over here.\c
I get if you’re upset, but don’t go full Kieran on
me, OK?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text: You probably think this is a skirt I’ve got on, huh?\c\nHeh heh! Not quite! I just tied my cape around\nmy waist.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_randomtalk_00

entries.text:
I’m really not made for learning in classrooms.
I’ve gotten held back...three times, I think?\c
But I get to savor the sweet school life longer
than everyone else. It’s a pretty good deal.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
Man, I love chairs. Don’t you love chairs?
What lifesavers.\c
I don’t get why everyone doesn’t just sit all the
time. Standing up’s tiring work![VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_randomtalk_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Your [VAR 0x0101(0001)] and I are getting along
great!\c
You can rest easy—I’m giving it all the care one
of my buds deserves.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_randomtalk_03

entries.text: That Duraludon I traded you loves being sparkly\nclean.\c\nGive it a good polishing now and then, would ya?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_randomtalk_04
